title: Team AI training for restaurants | Creosote Labs
meta_description: A one-day hands-on AI workshop for restaurant managers, run in the tool the business already uses. $1,000 per person, written guide and 30-day follow-up.
intro: Restaurant managers and owners spend a portion of every week on writing and administrative work rather than service. Typical items include weekly schedules in 7shifts or HotSchedules, vendor emails, catering proposals, staff training materials, responses to reviews on Google and Yelp, social media posts, and reports pulled from Toast or Square. Many restaurants already have an AI tool available through Google Workspace or Microsoft 365, and managers have often tried it once or twice without settling on a way to use it for those tasks.

Team AI training from Creosote Labs is a one-day workshop held at the restaurant or remotely, in the AI tool the business already uses. Managers bring their own laptops, menus, recipe files, and templates, and spend the day producing real work: a set of review responses, a catering proposal, a new-hire training outline, a monthly specials write-up. Each participant documents their own process. The team leaves with a written guide, and a follow-up session 30 days later covers what stuck and what did not.
projects: A workshop for a general manager and shift leads that produces a review-response playbook and a week of drafted replies.
A session for the catering manager that builds a proposal template and a follow-up email sequence from past event sheets.
A workshop for a restaurant group's managers that standardizes new-hire training documents across locations.
A session for the owner and bookkeeper that sets up monthly summaries of POS and labor exports.
A workshop for the front-of-house team on drafting menu descriptions, allergen notes, and specials copy from the chef's recipe sheet.

faqs.q: What does training cost for a restaurant team?
faqs.a: Training is $1,000 per person for up to 10 people, with a 5-person minimum. Larger teams are quoted and travel is included. A program with three monthly follow-up sessions is $1,400 per person.

faqs.q: Which AI tool is the workshop taught in?
faqs.a: The workshop runs in the tool the restaurant already uses, such as Google Gemini, Microsoft 365 Copilot, or Claude. Participants work on their own computers with their own documents.

faqs.q: Can the session be held on a closed day?
faqs.a: Yes, a closed day works well. The workshop is one day, on site or remote, and is scheduled around service. Each participant should bring a laptop and the documents they work with most.
